rule:
Apply the pre-registered selection rule to every recorded candidate and write the facts.

Rule (frozen 2026-11-09 in rec/fresh_collect.py PHYS + tools/run_selection.py, applied here unchanged):
  C1 fresh XR-1 rollout on split=target, failed at the task horizon;
  C2 physical change (plan.json 'phys'): object xy displacement >= 0.05 m or tilt >= 30 deg, and object z >= 0.35 m at T;
  C3 a recorded rescue from that state held the task's success for the last 10 of 15 hold steps (native). A rescue
     attempt is XR-1 run again from the restored state with a new noise seed, optionally after a short scripted
     prefix: V0/X(k%3=1) none; V1 / X(k%3=2) "retract": 12 steps gripper open, then up to 60 steps moving the hand
     0.12 m up and 0.15 m toward the base; V2 / X(k%3=0) "home": retract, then up to 200 steps servoing the hand to the
     rollout's step-0 pose. V0-V2 are tried in order at recording (stop at the first good one); X10, X11, ... are the
     extra attempts of the extra-rescue jobs (3 per failure, stop at the first good one, as far as their wall cap reached);
  C4 container (task wrapper): restore bit-exact to the recorded qpos, not successful at restore,
     the open-loop replay of the rescue recovers (10 consecutive success steps within 1500) in 3 of 3 runs;
  C5 no-op, blind (release, lift-retract, return to the start hand pose) and blind retry at the failure hand pose
     each do not recover within 1500 steps.
  C6 (added 2026-11-11 after review, before any frontier result, for oracle reproducibility across hosts): the replay
     also recovers in both runs with 1e-9 Gaussian noise added to every qpos entry at restore (seeds 1 and 2).
  A2 a job enters the hidden set only with at least 3 states kept by C1-C6 (added 2026-11-11).

verdicts.drop_C3: C3: no good rescue among the attempts listed
verdicts.drop_C5: C5: a blind baseline recovers it
verdicts.drop_C6: C6: replay fails under 1e-9 restore noise

note: Every rollout of the listed runs is here. Plans (seeds from os.urandom) were written before each run. C4-C6 ran in the task container with the task wrapper. C6 was added on 2026-11-11 after review, before any frontier result, for oracle reproducibility across hosts; it removed 5 states of the first freeze. Rescue attempts: name, scripted prefix, success, held for the last 10 hold steps.
